sloka: ततो ऽहमन्यद्विस्तीर्णं गत्वा तस्य गिरेस्तटम् ।तूष्णीं वर्षशतान्यष्टौ समाधारं महाव्रतम् ।। ७.१३.२५ ॥
transliteration: tato 'hamanyadvistīrṇaṁ gatvā tasya girestaṭam ।tūṣṇīṁ varṣaśatānyaṣṭau samādhāraṁ mahāvratam ।। 7.13.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, I went to another expansive slope of that mountain and silently observed a great vow for eight hundred years.
